```artifact
Feature: Alarms
  As a user
  I want the GUI to compute battery ETA and trigger alarms
  So that I can be notified of low battery levels

  Scenario: GUI computes battery ETA from history
    Given a history of remaining battery amounts
    When the GUI computes the battery ETA
    Then the battery ETA is calculated correctly

  Scenario: GUI is connected to a battery amount sensor
    Given a battery amount sensor is connected to the GUI
    When the GUI reads the battery amount
    Then the battery amount is displayed correctly

  Scenario: Low battery alarm is triggered
    Given the battery ETA is less than 30 minutes
    When the GUI computes the low battery alarm
    Then the low battery alarm is triggered with low priority

  Scenario: Critically low battery alarm is triggered
    Given the battery ETA is less than 10 minutes
    When the GUI computes the critically low battery alarm
    Then the critically low battery alarm is triggered with high priority

  Scenario: Battery failure alarm is triggered
    Given the battery is absent, unavailable, or unchargeable
    When the GUI computes the battery failure alarm
    Then the battery failure alarm is triggered

  Scenario Outline: GUI reads hardware battery presence and chargeability sensors
    Given the GUI is connected to the hardware battery presence and chargeability sensors
    When the GUI reads the sensors
    Then the sensors are read correctly
    Examples:
      | sensor_type | sensor_value |
      | presence    | present      |
      | presence    | absent       |
      | chargeability | chargeable   |
      | chargeability | unchargeable |

  Scenario Outline: GUI computes battery ETA with different history values
    Given a history of remaining battery amounts
    When the GUI computes the battery ETA
    Then the battery ETA is calculated correctly
    Examples:
      | history_value | expected_eta |
      | 100            | 1 hour       |
      | 50             | 30 minutes    |
      | 20             | 10 minutes    |
      | 0              | 0 minutes     |

  Scenario Outline: GUI triggers alarms with different battery ETA values
    Given the battery ETA is less than 30 minutes
    When the GUI computes the low battery alarm
    Then the low battery alarm is triggered with low priority
    Examples:
      | eta_value | alarm_triggered |
      | 25        | true            |
      | 35        | false           |
      | 0         | false           |

  Scenario Outline: GUI triggers alarms with different battery ETA values
    Given the battery ETA is less than 10 minutes
    When the GUI computes the critically low battery alarm
    Then the critically low battery alarm is triggered with high priority
    Examples:
      | eta_value | alarm_triggered |
      | 5         | true            |
      | 15        | false           |
      | 0         | false           |
```
